caption: Most happy customers never think to leave a review. They'd do it if someone asked at the right moment. If a friendly message went out after every finished job, with a simple link, how many more reviews would you have by now?

slides.headline: Your happy customers aren't leaving reviews.
The job went well. They said thanks.
slides.body: Then they got on with their day and never thought about it again.

slides.headline: Did anyone ask them?
slides.body: Most people will leave a review if you ask. Very few do it unprompted.

slides.headline: You mean to ask. Then you get busy.
slides.body: The next job starts and the moment passes.

slides.headline: What if the ask went out for you?
slides.body: Your agent messages after the job and sends a simple link.

slides.headline: Same good work. Now people see it.
slides.body: New customers check reviews before they call. Give them something to read.

beats.text: Your happy customers aren't leaving reviews.
They said thanks, then got on with their day.
Did anyone ask them? Most people only review when asked.
What if the ask went out after every job?
A friendly message and a link, sent for you.
beats.bubble: Thanks for having us today! Would you mind leaving a quick review? [link]
